limitations.note: The rewrite made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed input capture on the first clock after reset release, whereas the reference keeps `ready_a` low until that clock.
The fix registered `valid_b` but also gated it with `valid_a`, so it stays low when input stalls at count five instead of registering the count-five condition independently.

The passing test expected `valid_b` to be low during a stall at count five and explicitly required `ready_a` to be high during reset, encoding the rewrite’s assumptions rather than detecting either mismatch.
